//type: Declared so Node reads this app's .ts files as ES modules. Backend
tests import three of them directly under --experimental-strip-types,
and without this Node parsed each as CommonJS, failed, and reparsed
it as ESM, emitting MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON every run.
Safe here: the only .js files in this app are public/sw.js and its
template, which browsers fetch over HTTP and which this field does
not reach, and next.config.mjs is already explicit.
